local_commands: All three SDK-based command controls pass the full 32-case runtime suite twice and the compiled binding/transaction example. Fedora includes pgvector and 382 assertions per phase; Leap/AlmaLinux have336. Clean minimal runtime is a separate native-CI gate.
compiler_fixture: Same SQL/binding/return checks as debian/tests/compiler, executed with the RPM Unix-socket harness. Fixture-only addition; release2 RPM remains unchanged. Initial attempts to compile the full interpreter suite or move on_exit to top level were correctly rejected as unsupported by the pinned AOT compiler; neither is used in this fixture.
negative_controls: All three compiled programs return3 and the exact DBI:PGSQL:ERROR for the deliberately nonexistent socket. The output is captured and checked, not filtered.
status: Prepared for native ARM runtime/SDK qualification. AlmaLinux OBS waits on rebuilt dependencies.
